title: Kid Content Guardian family profile
description: Defines the household's kids and the rubric used to score streaming titles for each of them.

name.description: Used only for local display in diff reports; never sent to any external API.

max_maturity_rating.description: Ceiling for the platform's own maturity scale, expressed as a US TV/MPAA-style rating.

banned_themes.description: Common Sense Media theme/content tags this kid should never be shown, regardless of overall rating (e.g. 'violence', 'scary_imagery', 'romance').

max_pacing_score.description: Ceiling on the 1-10 stimulation/pacing score (1 = calmest, 10 = most frenetic). Titles above this are blocked even if the maturity rating fits.

allow_titles.description: Explicit per-kid overrides that always pass, even if the rubric would otherwise block them.

block_titles.description: Explicit per-kid overrides that always block, even if the rubric would otherwise allow them.

platform_profiles.description: Maps a kid's name to the profile name used on each streaming platform, so discovered catalogs can be attributed correctly.
